theme_and_archetype.description: A premium, high-end football championship aesthetic. Dark background heavily utilizes obsidian and midnight tones, accented by a vibrant but sophisticated gold system. Avoids typical 'fintech-bro' or neon 'cyberpunk' looks. UI must feel tactile, cinematic, and authoritative.

body.style: clean, highly readable on mobile data-heavy views

navigation.admin_tab_bar: fixed bottom-0 w-full h-16 bg-[#151821] border-t border-white/5 flex justify-around items-center z-50

glass_cards.strategy: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) for premium event displays.

hero_stadium_dark.description: Dark football stadium at night. Perfect for the main player dashboard header or background.

gold_texture_abstract.description: Gold metallic foil texture. Good to use as an overlaid texture for premium cards or high-rank leaderboards (with multiply/screen blend modes).

data_testid_guidelines.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first responsive layout (use a max-width container like max-w-md mx-auto on desktop screens to simulate a mobile app frame).
Use pure HTML and Tailwind for layout structures, and Shadcn UI strictly for complex interactions (dropdowns, tabs, dialogs).

Implement two distinct flows: A Portuguese 'Player' flow featuring heavy glassmorphism, gold accents, and gamification UI, and an English 'Admin/Governor' flow featuring tighter density, neumorphic borders, and red/green alert states for SafeLock.
Ensure 'Game HC' is clearly presented as an in-game asset, with the Portuguese disclaimer highly visible during reward flows.
Integrate provided images for hero headers and event backgrounds with a strong black/gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0B10] to-transparent) so text contrast remains AA compliant.
